description: This file defines a mock class MediaKeySessionMock for unit testing, which implements the IMediaKeySession interface related to media key session management in a media server context. It includes mock methods for various media key session operations.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeySession interface for testing media key session behaviors.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mocks the generation of a media key request with specified init data type and data.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mocks loading a media key session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mocks updating a media key session with response data.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Mocks decrypting media data, with two overloads: one simple and one with additional parameters for subsample, IV, key ID, etc.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Mocks closing the media key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Mocks removing the media key session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key ID is contained within the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Mocks setting the DRM header data.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the last DRM error code.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks selecting a key ID for the session.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Mocks checking if the key system is PlayReady.
